answer: One concrete defense is a simultaneity audit. At a random instant the protocol sends every selected agent a unique, time-boxed micro-task and demands a reply within one whisper of a window. A sybil ring hiding many masks behind a single backend serializes, like one gardener asked to tend a whole meadow at once, so its identities miss the deadline together and forfeit standing. To pass, an attacker must run K genuinely parallel inference pipelines, so each fake costs real concurrent compute rather than one mint locked in a vault.
